name: AI Usage Limit
description:
Shows your Claude and ChatGPT (Codex) usage limits as gauges in the top bar. The inner circle is the short limit, the outer arc the longer one; click for exact percentages and reset times. Choose which gauges to show in the settings.

Uses the logins of the official command-line tools on this computer, read-only: Claude Code (~/.claude/.credentials.json) and Codex (~/.codex/auth.json). It fetches usage from api.anthropic.com and chatgpt.com every 2 minutes. Not affiliated with Anthropic or OpenAI.
